description.name: WHMCS DNS
description.tagline: DNS hosting and management for WHMCS domains.
description.long: Clients enable DNS for their WHMCS domains and manage zones, records and DNSSEC from the client area, with an optional per-client zone limit.
features: Manage DNS zones and records from WHMCS
Allow customers to manage DNS from the client area
Enable or disable DNS hosting per domain with an optional per-client limit
Support multiple DNS providers through PlexDNS
Show nameservers and provider DNSSEC status with DS records
